cohort: 384 primigravida women delivering singleton babies were screened for maternal weight and labor-related parameters.
finding: This study concluded that a correlation exists between maternal weight and labor-related parameters.
cross-section timing: Data was collected around the time of delivery and immediate postpartum.
gest_age: varied, including preterm (42.2%), postterm (24.5%), and term (33.3%) deliveries.
